output.text: {"notes":["All requested outputs are terminal readouts at absolute time t=2.0 s; joint angles are unwrapped and expressed in joint-local frames.","Tip position is a world-frame vector in metres. The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up.","Both joints receive constant -0.3996287839 N·m torque over [0,2.0), with 0.05 N·m·s/rad viscous damping; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m over [0.5708,0.6708).","joint_limit_by_T is true if either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the target time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
